title: Hub: authorize the Removes the did_webvh rules require without canRemoveOwnClient
description: Follow-up to decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.25 reading (b). Today a revocation Commit's Remove of the user's own revoked device needs canRemoveOwnClient in room policy; mimid-agent's default member role now has it, but rooms made before, or by other clients, may not. The Observer could report which Removes the rules required (leaf's SCID = committer's SCID, key not in the record the same Commit sets), and hub/policy.rs could authorize those without a capability. Needs a decision bead on whether room policy may be bypassed for this.
